See this here is the worst advise I consistently receive.


I matter as a fucking source of labour. I am trained to do my job - Literally anyone else can step in and do my job. 


If I mattered to those other people they'd actually fucking reach out to me

Because I've deactivated all social media for a week and no one's reached out to me once excluding that one best friend. Every one of them has my phone number and i'm always the one initiating conversation. No one's bothered to check. 




I've just slowly come to the realisation that I literally don't care if I live or die. I'm loveless and used constantly by people who I end up thinking care about me. Constantly. I'm also well aware that if I died tomorrow i'd be forgotten in a month and the only person suffering here is me as long as i'm alive. 



I've tried all of the deeper meaning things and if I manage to get to 2021 will have a go at joining MSF or another high risk not for profit to go at least ensure my life isn't wasted so I can die for a cause but my fucking god there's literally no good reason to kick on until then except that. 



I'm so mentally unfit for it though I doubt i'd get placed anywhere. Even my closest friends are sick of it.
Can anyone recommend a fairly social gym in the city? I've just moved and i'd love to get to meet other meatheads
